basicDetails.schemeName: Subsidized Scheme for Widows: Haryana Women Development Corporation

children.text: The applicant must be a Haryana-domiciled widow, divorced, or a legally separated Woman.
The applicant's annual income should not exceed ₹3,00,000/- per annum.
The age of the prospective beneficiary should be between 18 and 55 years at the time of applying for the loan.

eligibilityCriteria.eligibilityDescription_md: 1. The applicant must be a Haryana-domiciled widow, divorced, or a legally separated Woman. 1. The applicant's annual income should not exceed ₹3,00,000/- per annum. 1. The age of the prospective beneficiary should be between 18 and 55 years at the time of applying for the loan.

children.text: A 25% flat subsidy, subject to a maximum of ₹50,000/-, will be provided on the total loan (not as a capital subsidy).
The beneficiary's share is 10% of the total loan.
The scheme will be covered under without collateral security by the bank.
The balance amount will be covered from commercial/nationalised banks.
The balance amount will be covered from commercial/nationalised banks.
The moratorium period will be three months after disbursement of the loan.

schemeContent.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to Haryana Domiciled Widow, Divorced, and Legally Separated Women. Through this scheme, a subsidy on the total loan is provided.

children.text: The scheme "Subsidized Scheme for Widows" by the Women & Child Development Department, Haryana Government, aims to provide financial assistance to Haryana-domiciled widows, divorced, and Legally Separated Women. Through this scheme, a subsidy on the total loan is provided. The scheme is covered without collateral security by the bank. The scheme is implemented by the Haryana Women Development Corporation.
